picks.thesis: Bear call spread on SPY expires in 2 days with a short call delta of 0.32, credit $0.35 and a 1‑point width (credit‑to‑width 0.35). The delta sits in the middle of the typical 0.25‑0.35 band, offering a good risk‑reward for a very short‑term trade.

Bull put spread on QQQ expires in 1 day, short put delta -0.3265, credit $0.47 on a 2‑point width (credit‑to‑width 0.235). The delta is near the sweet‑spot and the credit per width is among the highest, making it attractive for a quick event‑risk play.

rejects.reason: Lower credit ($0.24) and delta (0.26) give weaker reward for the same 1‑day horizon.
